items.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
items.description: Around 200 emergency personnel are deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.

items.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
items.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

items.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
items.description: The Student List has emerged from almost two years of anti-corruption protests to form the biggest challenge to Vučić's rule.

items.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
items.description: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

items.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack
items.description: The independent MP is now in a serious but stable condition, according to the Melbourne hospital.

items.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
items.description: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

items.title: Seven missing after multi-storey building collapses in Kenya's capital
items.description: Rescue efforts are under way to find people trapped under the block, which was still under construction when it buckled.

items.title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
items.description: The justice department has filed a lawsuit arguing that the inclusion of two candidates named Dan Sullivan could confuse voters.

items.title: Minneapolis withdrawal was 'surrender', Trump's ex-border patrol chief tells BBC
items.description: Greg Bovino was the public face of the controversial immigration enforcement operation in the city earlier this year.

items.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
items.description: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

items.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
items.description: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

items.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
items.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

items.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
items.description: Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.

items.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
items.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.

items.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
items.description: Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention.

items.title: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
items.description: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife

items.title: Who actually controls Ukraine's access to Starlink?
items.description: President Zelensky says limits to the technology continue to affect Ukrainian forces, while US officials and Elon Musk offer conflicting accounts of who controls it.

items.title: Doctors tell the BBC about the targeting of Sudanese hospitals by paramilitary fighters
items.description: A BBC investigation has found evidence that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed el-Fasher's healthcare system.

items.title: Blue Planet III: Moment octopus escapes death after hunt gone wrong
items.description: The sequence is part of the latest Blue Planet series from Sir David Attenborough.

items.title: 'It's part of the culture' - New York bans horse-drawn carriages after more than 160 years
items.description: The BBC's Madeline Halpert spoke to city tourists, residents and horse carriage workers about the industry and their opinion on the ban.
